vulnerabilities.description: Cookie set with insecure path attribute.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Set the path attribute of the cookie to a secure value, such as "/" or "". This will prevent the cookie from being sent with unsecured requests. Additionally, consider using the Secure flag on the cookie to ensure it is only transmitted over HTTPS connections.

vulnerabilities.description: Cookie set with insecure domain attribute.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Set the domain attribute of the cookie to a secure value, such as the domain name of your application. This will prevent the cookie from being sent with unsecured requests.
